translations.en: {count, plural, one {# min read} other {# min read}}

strings.description: The figure line UNDER the map on the Abriss-Atlas screen. {reports} counts reported demolitions, {cities} the cities they come from. DE/CH is Germany and Switzerland and stays as it is.

translations.en: {reports, plural, one {One reported demolition} other {# reported demolitions}} in {cities, plural, one {one city} other {# cities}} (DE/CH)

strings.description: The group heading over the research-diary entries on the Backstage screen. `diary.screenTitle` is the same words as the name of a single entry's route, which on the web target is the browser tab.
On a Backstage card for a piece members read before everybody else. {date} is a weekday out of the content, already written as a word and in German, not a formatted date.
The contribution count on a CrowdNewsroom callout's card. {count} is how many people have contributed. The survey's own wording is callout.survey.count.

strings.english: {count, plural, one {One contribution} other {# contributions}} so far
strings.description: The contribution count with ‘so far’, on the callout teaser on the HOME screen, and only for a CrowdNewsroom callout: the card on the participation tab says `callout.crowdnewsroom.count` without ‘so far’, and a survey says `callout.survey.countSoFar`. {count} is how many people have contributed. Word for word identical to `callout.detail.responses`, which is the detail screen's line and is printed for every kind of callout; the two are separate on purpose and must not be merged.

translations.de: {count, plural, one {Ein Beitrag} other {# Beiträge}} bisher
translations.en: {count, plural, one {One contribution} other {# contributions}} so far

strings.description: The button on a CrowdNewsroom callout, on the card on the participation tab and on the teaser on the home screen. On the card it is replaced by `callout.contributeAgain` once this person has contributed. One of five ids reading ‘Take part’: the survey's button is `callout.survey.cta`, the detail screen's is `callout.detail.cta`, the tab is `ui.tabParticipate` and the screen heading is `participate.title`.

strings.english: ✓ You have contributed already, thank you! More tips are welcome.

translations.de: ✓ Sie haben bereits beigetragen, danke! Weitere Hinweise sind willkommen.
translations.en: ✓ You have contributed already, thank you! More tips are welcome.

strings.description: The button on a callout's own screen, whatever kind of callout it is. The card and the home teaser have their own, `callout.crowdnewsroom.cta` and `callout.survey.cta`.

Shown when the callout screen is opened with no identifier at all, which is a broken link rather than a wrong one. Four other screens say the same thing under claim.noId, diary.noId, project.noId and series.noId.

strings.english: {count, plural, one {One contribution} other {# contributions}} so far
strings.description: The contribution count on a callout's own screen, printed for every kind of callout. Reads identically to `callout.crowdnewsroom.countSoFar`, which is the home teaser's line and is worded per kind. {count} is how many people have contributed.

translations.de: {count, plural, one {Ein Beitrag} other {# Beiträge}} bisher
translations.en: {count, plural, one {One contribution} other {# contributions}} so far

strings.description: Shown when the callout screen is opened with an identifier no callout has. {slug} is that identifier, unchanged, in quotation marks.
The response count on a survey callout's card. {count} is how many people have answered. A survey gets responses where a CrowdNewsroom gets contributions, which is callout.crowdnewsroom.count.

strings.english: {count, plural, one {One response} other {# responses}} so far
strings.description: The response count with ‘so far’, on the callout teaser on the home screen, for a survey callout. {count} is how many people have answered.

translations.de: {count, plural, one {Eine Teilnahme} other {# Teilnahmen}} bisher
translations.en: {count, plural, one {One response} other {# responses}} so far

strings.description: The button on a survey callout, on the card on the participation tab and on the teaser on the home screen. German says ‘Teilnehmen’ here and ‘Mitmachen’ on a CrowdNewsroom, `callout.crowdnewsroom.cta`, although English says ‘Take part’ for both.
The accessible name of a callout teaser on the home screen, read aloud and never seen. {cta} is the button's own label and {title} the callout's headline.
The kicker above a callout teaser on the home screen. {kicker} is the callout's own kicker; the word before the separator is the app's.

Under a source on a claim's screen. {level} is the source's reliability exactly as the data holds it, the literal German words `hoch`, `mittel` or `niedrig`, and it is NOT translated anywhere. Leave it in the sentence as it arrives; getting it translated is a change to the code, not to this string.
Shown when the claim screen is opened with no identifier at all. Four other screens say the same thing under callout.detail.noSlug, diary.noId, project.noId and series.noId.

strings.english: No sources yet. The community is gathering them.

translations.de: Noch keine Quellen. Die Community sammelt.
translations.en: No sources yet. The community is gathering them.

strings.description: The claim itself, on its own screen, in quotation marks. {quote} is the claim's wording and is not translated. The quotation marks belong to the language: German uses low and high ones.
One step of the progress row on a claim's screen. `participate.claimChecking` is the same word in the status tag a few lines above it on the same screen, so the two are read together.
One step of the progress row on a claim's screen. `participate.claimSubmitted` is the same word in the status tag a few lines above it on the same screen, so the two are read together.

strings.english: Submit a tip of your own (in the Faktenforum)

translations.en: Submit a tip of your own (in the Faktenforum)

strings.english: Playback was interrupted. Check your connection and try again.

translations.de: Wiedergabe unterbrochen. Prüfen Sie Ihre Internetverbindung und versuchen Sie es erneut.
translations.en: Playback was interrupted. Check your connection and try again.

translations.de: Wiedergabe nicht möglich. Prüfen Sie Ihre Internetverbindung und versuchen Sie es erneut.

translations.de: Auf dieser Plattform ist keine Wiedergabe möglich.
translations.en: Playback is not available on this platform.

strings.description: The byline in the article document the reader renders. {authors} is the list of authors, already joined.
The badge on a fact check inside the article document. Uppercased by the code that builds the document, so write it in normal case. home.factCheckBadge is the same word on the home screen's rail.

Part of the meta line in the article document, after the byline and the date and joined to them with ‘ · ’. {minutes} is a whole number of minutes. There is no plural here, unlike `article.readingTime` in the feed; say so if your language needs one.

strings.english: Made possible by supporters like you. Thank you for being here.

translations.de: Ermöglicht durch Unterstützer:innen wie Sie. Danke, dass Sie dabei sind.
translations.en: Made possible by supporters like you. Thank you for being here.

strings.description: Shown when the diary screen is opened with no identifier at all. Four other screens say the same thing under callout.detail.noSlug, claim.noId, project.noId and series.noId.

The diary route's name. On the web target it is the browser tab's title; on iOS and Android the header does not draw it. `backstage.diaryLabel` is the same words as the group heading over the diary entries on the Backstage screen.

Shown when the diary screen is opened with an identifier no entry has. {id} is that identifier, unchanged, in quotation marks. Three other screens say the same under `claim.unknownId`, `project.unknownId` and `series.unknownId`.
The heading of the Discover screen. ui.tabDiscover is the same word on the tab bar, where it has far less room.

strings.english: The community checks claims together with the CORRECTIV newsroom. Have a look at what is being worked on.

translations.de: Die Community prüft Behauptungen, gemeinsam mit der CORRECTIV-Redaktion. Schauen Sie, was gerade in Arbeit ist.
translations.en: The community checks claims together with the CORRECTIV newsroom. Have a look at what is being worked on.

strings.description: A claim in the Faktenforum list, in quotation marks. {quote} is the claim's wording and is not translated. The quotation marks belong to the language: German uses low and high ones. `claim.quote` is the same construction on a claim's own screen.
The line under a claim in the Faktenforum list. {shortId} is the claim's short identifier and {date} the day it was submitted, already formatted.

The button that steps back one page in the participation form. `ui.back` is the same word in a screen header elsewhere, but not on this screen: its header says `form.cancel` so that two controls do not both say ‘Back’.

strings.english: {count, plural, one {One person has} other {# people have}} contributed so far.
strings.description: On the thank-you page of the participation form. {count} is how many people have contributed to this callout.

translations.de: {count, plural, one {Ein Mensch hat} other {# Menschen haben}} bereits beigetragen.
translations.en: {count, plural, one {One person has} other {# people have}} contributed so far.

strings.description: The file picker's own label in the participation form once something is attached, replacing `form.filePick` in the same control. {file} is the file's name. The tick is part of the message.

strings.english: See more ways to take part

translations.en: See more ways to take part

strings.description: The button that steps forward one page in the participation form. onboarding.next is the same word in the onboarding, which is a different sequence.
The progress line above the participation form. {current} is the page being filled in and {total} how many there are.

strings.english: Your contribution goes into the investigation. The newsroom reviews every tip. We will get in touch if anything is unclear.

translations.de: Ihr Beitrag fließt in die Recherche ein. Die Redaktion prüft alle Hinweise. Bei Rückfragen melden wir uns.
translations.en: Your contribution goes into the investigation. The newsroom reviews every tip. We will get in touch if anything is unclear.

strings.description: Shown when the form is opened for a callout that does not exist. {slug} is the identifier that was passed, unchanged, in quotation marks.

strings.english: correctiv.org cannot be reached at the moment. Please try again in a few minutes.

translations.de: correctiv.org ist gerade nicht erreichbar. Bitte versuchen Sie es in ein paar Minuten noch einmal.
translations.en: correctiv.org cannot be reached at the moment. Please try again in a few minutes.

strings.english: That email address and password do not match. Please check both.

translations.de: E-Mail-Adresse oder Passwort stimmen nicht. Bitte prüfen Sie beides.

strings.english: Become a member with a contribution

translations.en: Become a member with a contribution

translations.de: Diese App ist der Ort für Mitglieder mit Beitrag. Ihr Konto ist dasselbe wie auf correctiv.org.
translations.en: This app is the place for members who contribute. Your account is the same one you use on correctiv.org.

strings.description: The value of the 'App access' row at the door, for somebody whose trial has run out. {date} is the day it ended, already formatted.

strings.english: Good to have you with us.

translations.en: Good to have you with us.

strings.english: Your trial ended on {date}. Thank you for trying the app. With a contribution it carries on here, with everything you already know.
strings.description: The paragraph at the door for somebody whose trial has run out. {date} is the day it ended, already formatted.

translations.de: Ihre Testphase ist am {date} zu Ende gegangen. Danke, dass Sie die App ausprobiert haben. Mit einem Beitrag geht es hier weiter, mit allem, was Sie schon kennen.
translations.en: Your trial ended on {date}. Thank you for trying the app. With a contribution it carries on here, with everything you already know.

strings.english: The app is part of membership with a contribution.

translations.de: Die App gehört zur Mitgliedschaft mit Beitrag.
translations.en: The app is part of membership with a contribution.

strings.description: Above the headline at the door, for somebody who is signed in but has no app access. {email} is their address.

strings.english: Nothing is transmitted. After "{button}", "{recheck}" finds a membership with a contribution.
strings.description: The note at the door that says this demonstration transmits nothing. {button} and {recheck} are two of the buttons on the same screen, interpolated so that renaming one cannot leave this sentence naming a control that no longer exists.

translations.de: Es wird nichts übertragen. Nach „{button}“ findet „{recheck}“ eine Mitgliedschaft mit Beitrag.
translations.en: Nothing is transmitted. After "{button}", "{recheck}" finds a membership with a contribution.

strings.english: Sign in with a different account

translations.en: Sign in with a different account

strings.english: Your account is on the free tier. It keeps everything on correctiv.org open to you. The app comes with the contribution: it funds the investigations, and in return there is audio, video and formats that exist only here.

translations.de: Ihr Konto hat die kostenlose Stufe. Damit lesen Sie weiter alles auf correctiv.org. Die App kommt mit dem Beitrag dazu: Er finanziert die Recherchen, und dafür gibt es hier Audio, Video und Formate, die es nur in der App gibt.
translations.en: Your account is on the free tier. It keeps everything on correctiv.org open to you. The app comes with the contribution: it funds the investigations, and in return there is audio, video and formats that exist only here.

strings.description: The value of the 'Your tier' row at the door. settings.access.trial is the same word in the settings, where it describes how access was granted rather than which tier the account is on.

strings.english: Nothing is transmitted. Every address signs in: with "frei" as the free tier without app access, with "test" during the trial, with "lokal" through the local bundle. A password shorter than four characters fails.

translations.de: Es wird nichts übertragen. Jede Adresse meldet an: mit „frei“ als kostenlose Stufe ohne App-Zugang, mit „test“ in der Testphase, mit „lokal“ über das Lokal-Bundle. Ein Passwort unter vier Zeichen schlägt fehl.
translations.en: Nothing is transmitted. Every address signs in: with "frei" as the free tier without app access, with "test" during the trial, with "lokal" through the local bundle. A password shorter than four characters fails.

strings.description: The badge on a card in the home screen's fact-check rail. core.reader.factcheckBadge is the same word inside the article document, where it is uppercased.

translations.de: CORRECTIV ist gemeinnützig. Ihr Beitrag finanziert die Recherchen, die hier stehen.

strings.english: Made possible by supporters like you

translations.en: Videos cannot be reached at the moment.

translations.en: Your selection orders the home screen.

strings.description: The button that steps forward one page in the onboarding. form.next is the same word in the participation form.

strings.english: In the CrowdNewsroom thousands of people contribute to investigations. In the Faktenforum the community checks claims. You find both in the "Mitmachen" tab.

translations.de: Im CrowdNewsroom tragen tausende Menschen zu Recherchen bei. Im Faktenforum prüft die Community Behauptungen. Beides finden Sie im Tab „Mitmachen“.

strings.description: The status tag on a claim, in the Faktenforum list and at the top of a claim's own screen. {verdict} is the verdict, already translated, or the word under participate.claimNoVerdict when the check closed without one.

The status tag on a claim, in the Faktenforum list and at the top of a claim's own screen. `claim.stage.checking` is the same word a few lines below it on that same screen, in the progress row. The status tag on a claim, in the Faktenforum list and at the top of a claim's own screen. `claim.stage.submitted` is the same word a few lines below it on that same screen, in the progress row. The two are separate ids and are read together, so word them alike unless the progress row needs a form of its own.

strings.english: In the community area you discuss investigations with other members, and soon in the app as well.

translations.de: Im Community-Bereich diskutieren Sie Recherchen mit anderen Mitgliedern, bald auch in der App.
translations.en: In the community area you discuss investigations with other members, and soon in the app as well.

strings.english: The community checks claims from around the web, guided by the newsroom. Right now {count, plural, one {one claim is} other {# claims are}} being worked on.
strings.description: The paragraph about the Faktenforum on the participation tab. {count} is how many claims the Faktenforum holds altogether, the finished ones included, not only the ones still open.

translations.en: The community checks claims from around the web, guided by the newsroom. Right now {count, plural, one {one claim is} other {# claims are}} being worked on.

translations.de: Recherchen entstehen mit Ihnen. Ihre Hinweise, Beobachtungen und Prüfungen machen sie erst möglich.
translations.en: Investigations are made with you. Your tips, your observations and your checks are what make them possible.

strings.english: Seen a suspicious claim? Send it straight to the fact-checking desk.

translations.de: Verdächtige Behauptung gesehen? Schicken Sie sie direkt der Faktencheck-Redaktion.
translations.en: Seen a suspicious claim? Send it straight to the fact-checking desk.

strings.description: The heading of the participation screen. ui.tabParticipate is the same word on the tab bar, where it has far less room, and three callout buttons say it too.

strings.description: The mini player's state line while a track is loading. video.loading is the same word on the video screen.
Under the name on the membership card. {tier} is the tier's name, already translated, and {date} the day the membership began, already formatted.

strings.english: Your contribution makes these investigations possible.{articles, select, some { Among others, these:} other {}}
strings.description: The impact card's sentence when the membership carries no start date. {articles} is a choice and not a value: `some` when investigations are listed under the card, `other` when there are none. translations.de: Ihr Beitrag ermöglicht diese Recherchen.{articles, select, some { Unter anderem diese hier:} other {}}

strings.english: You have been supporting CORRECTIV {months, plural, one {for a short while} other {for # months}}.{articles, select, some { Among others, these investigations were made possible:} other {}}
strings.description: The impact card's sentence when the membership's months can be counted. {months} is never below one, so the singular branch is the phrase for ‘not long’ and the plural branch counts. {articles} is a choice and not a value: `some` when investigations are listed under the card, `other` when there are none.

translations.de: Sie unterstützen CORRECTIV {months, plural, one {seit Kurzem} other {seit # Monaten}}.{articles, select, some { Unter anderem diese Recherchen wurden mit ermöglicht:} other {}}
translations.en: You have been supporting CORRECTIV {months, plural, one {for a short while} other {for # months}}.{articles, select, some { Among others, these investigations were made possible:} other {}}

translations.en: You manage your contribution, your payment method and your data in your account on correctiv.org.

strings.description: The accessible name of one text-size button, read aloud and never seen. {scale} is the sample letters the button shows; it is one message so the language decides where the sample goes.
The way back out of a screen, in the header. form.back is the same word inside the participation form, where it steps back one page rather than leaving.
A tab on the tab bar, where there is room for one short word. discover.title is the same word as the heading of the screen it opens.
A tab on the tab bar, where there is room for one short word. participate.title is the same word as the heading of the screen it opens.
A tab on the tab bar, where there is room for one short word. profile.title is the same word as the heading of the screen it opens.
The accessible name of a video card, read aloud and never seen. {title} is the video's title.
The accessible name of the frame the video is embedded in, read aloud and never seen. `video.screenTitle` is the same word as the route's name and `video.kicker` the one above the title.

The kicker above a video's title, and only on a video older than seven days: anything newer gets `video.newEpisode` instead. `video.screenTitle` is the same word as the route's name, which on the web target is the browser tab.
On the video screen, in place of the native player while there is no stream address yet. Not the loading state itself, which is a spinner. `player.loading` is the same word in the mini player.

The video route's name. On the web target it is the browser tab's title; on iOS and Android the header does not draw it, so nobody sees it there. `video.kicker` is the word above the video's own title and `video.frameTitle` names the embed.
Under a video's title. {count} is how often it has been watched.
The button that leaves the app for the platform the video is hosted on. {host} is that platform's host name, such as youtube.com.
